decisions.reason: The modular waste processing concept builds on the firm's core offer, fits its announced modular direction and is publicly backed by a quantified savings claim of more than 600,000 euros per year, so dropping it would write off visible investment and contradict that claim.
The slow-speed shredder sits close to the established range, has a product page of its own signalling visible commitment, and nothing suggests results that temporary causes could not explain.

As a multi-model product line presented as the flagship of the firm's direction, it carries heavy investment and public commitment, so management would persist with it and attribute any weakness to temporary causes.

The trommel screen is a natural part of the mobile recycling portfolio and supports after-sales business; although it has less visible commitment, there is no evidence of lasting failure that would justify dropping it.
